causal_change: Split the terminal producer into a provisional policy producer followed by an independent terminal falsifier and finalizer.
expected_effect: The visible sequential handoff should prevent authorship from implicitly serving as acceptance, so final emission reflects an independent review of causal support and contract preservation.
falsifier: Falsified unless every artifact in the precommitted matched R0-versus-R1 evaluation is contract-valid and R1 achieves both a strict majority of matched-pair wins and a strictly better median on the precommitted aggregate objective; any invalidity, non-majority, or non-improving median falsifies the claim.
observed_bottleneck: The one-call graph makes provisional authorship and post-build causal adjudication inseparable, leaving no independently visible acceptance boundary.
